creator: griffybit
statement: Making a party dungeon class tier list from his own opinion plus Twitch chat to guide which character to play.

creator: griffybit
statement: Archer is D tier in party dungeons; its only strength is Piercing Arrow hitting multiple enemies.

creator: griffybit
statement: Archer basic auto attacks are single target and slow; Piercing Arrow and Kung Fu Kick won't carry it early mid or late in party dungeons.

creator: griffybit
statement: Archer gets a bit better once you reach subclasses.

creator: griffybit
statement: Warrior is C tier due to Power Strike and Whirl.

creator: griffybit
statement: Power Strike works as near auto attack reset because of damage scaling in party dungeons; Whirl is AoE; warrior auto attacks are passive AoE.

creator: griffybit
statement: Mage is C tier because of Energy Bolt and Mini Fireball.

creator: griffybit
statement: Energy Bolt is decent single target stacking on auto attack; Fireball is extra damage with chance of AoE.

creator: griffybit
statement: Biggest problem for magic users is mana; you barely cast spells until you rank up and spend credits on mana.

creator: griffybit
statement: Magic users get better in later game once mana is built up.

creator: griffybit
statement: Mage players starting party dungeons spend most credits on mana instead of class weapons base damage or total damage.

creator: griffybit
statement: Journeyman is F tier; its only ability is the whip.

creator: griffybit
statement: Whip does little damage and pulls enemies toward you so you are likely to die using it.

creator: griffybit
statement: In party dungeons you don't get Journeyman's double hit passive; it is single hit single target with a pull.

creator: griffybit
statement: Bowman is C tier; abilities Flax Into String Magic Shortbow and Homing Arrows plus Piercing Arrow and Kung Fu Kick.

creator: griffybit
statement: Flax into string does not do enough damage at high level since damage is scaled down in party dungeons; Magic Shortbow has little AoE.

creator: griffybit
statement: Homing Arrows is bugged and inconsistent; arrows may hit a mob or fly off and miss even beside a creature.

creator: griffybit
statement: Bowman gets C tier due to inconsistency and long range slow single target damage.

creator: griffybit
statement: Hunter is B tier; 360 No Scope and Bear Trap give more consistency than Bowman.

creator: griffybit
statement: 360 No Scope gives a bit more AoE alongside Piercing Arrow.

creator: griffybit
statement: Bear Trap is inconsistent; can't level it up in party dungeons so you lack max traps; mostly works in world 1 party dungeons.

creator: griffybit
statement: Hunter stays just above Bowman but not much better.

creator: griffybit
statement: Shaman would be S tier but for early game mana problems; one of the highest MP spending abilities.

creator: griffybit
statement: At the beginning the only usable thing is the vials; crazy concoctions have huge damage and are viable in many situations.

creator: griffybit
statement: Auspicious Aura is very good for consistent boss damage.

creator: griffybit
statement: Sizzling Skull is not great because of inconsistent bounces; enemies aren't lined up in world 1 2 or 3 party dungeons.

creator: griffybit
statement: Shaman is A tier with concoctions aura energy bolt and mini fireball being viable; would be S without mana issues.

creator: griffybit
statement: Squire is top S tier thanks to Shockwave Slash and Dagger Rang; both AoE and high damage even early.

creator: griffybit
statement: Squire also has Power Strike for auto attack reset Whirl for AoE and passive AoE auto attacks; great for clearing.

creator: griffybit
statement: Dagger Rang can hit the boss multiple times giving strong boss damage.

creator: griffybit
statement: Wizard is A tier due to Ice Shards Floor is Lava and Tornado.

creator: griffybit
statement: Wizard abilities cost less mana than shaman's but you still run out and must spend credits on mana over total damage base damage or class weapon.

creator: griffybit
statement: Tornado has incredible AoE and does great boss damage; Floor is Lava is fantastic for clearing mobs with AoE.

creator: griffybit
statement: Ice Shards slow is one of the only CC in the game and is very good in world 1 2 and 3 party dungeons.

creator: griffybit
statement: Wizard has slow plus mini fireball energy bolt and some Ice Shards AoE; A tier very viable but needs a lot of build up.

creator: griffybit
statement: Barbarian is S tier for much the same reasons as Squire.

creator: griffybit
statement: Bear Swipe can hit the platform above you instead of going straight like Shockwave Slash; Axe Rl helps set up hitting enemies on top platform.

creator: griffybit
statement: Barbarian has AoE auto attacks Whirl from warrior tab and Power Strike for auto reset.

creator: griffybit
statement: Barbarian and Squire are viable in early and late game so deserve S tier.

creator: griffybit
statement: Maestro was forgotten and put at A tier though considered S-tier character.

creator: griffybit
statement: Coin Toss is strong AoE and like shaman vials but bounces for multiple damage; whip is not viable.

creator: griffybit
statement: Level 85 Maestro weapon Celtic Ordeal can be worn instead of a class weapon in party dungeons keeping its fast attack speed.

creator: griffybit
statement: Celtic Ordeal gives no dungeon power from the weapon but scales out in the long run.

creator: griffybit
statement: RNG item Stardew Drop benefits Maestro far more than any other class.

creator: griffybit
statement: Without Celtic Ordeal Maestro loses attack speed and relies on Coin Toss; no triple or double punch in party dungeons.

creator: griffybit
statement: Maestro single target relies on Handy Pick Sugar Rush Grey Grumbles and Stardew Drop unless you have RNG voucher.

creator: griffybit
statement: Only about the 1 percent have the Celtic Ordeal early; if everyone did Maestro would be S tier.

creator: griffybit
statement: Outro asking for feedback on the tier list and promoting Twitch stream.
